title: incident-bot: add contextual on-call runbook & SLO quicklinks
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds contextual quicklinks to relevant runbooks and SLO pages in incident-bot; includes heuristics for scoring links and telemetry for click-through analytics.
description:
Motivation: On-call engineers often need immediate access to runbooks and SLO pages related to the alert. This PR augments incident-bot to surface contextual quicklinks (runbooks, SLO dashboards, remediation playbooks) in alert messages and the on-call UI.

What this change does: Implements a scoring pipeline that matches alert metadata (service, slo_id, error_class, tags) to candidate runbooks and SLO pages, ranks results, and exposes the top 3 quicklinks in bot messages and the web UI. Adds a lightweight caching layer to avoid repeated lookups for noisy alerts and emits telemetry for link impressions/clicks so we can measure usefulness.

Key features: - runbook/slo scoring heuristics (service match, tag overlap, historical click-through) - fallback suggestions when exact SLO metadata is missing (keyword-based matching) - opt-in telemetry events: quicklink_impression, quicklink_click, quicklink_fallback - on-call UI: quicklinks panel with copy/paste and open-in-new-tab actions - admin config flags for tuning max links and cache TTL

Tests and CI: unit tests for scoring engine, integration tests for bot message rendering, and an end-to-end smoke test exercising the on-call UI link flow. Addressed a flaky e2e by increasing test timeouts and making the mock indexer deterministic.

Migration/ops notes: New telemetry metrics require a minor update to observability ingestion (schema v2 for event type quicklink_*). The feature is behind a feature-flag (incident_bot.quicklinks.enabled) and defaulted off for managed deployments; Dedicated/Private customers can opt-in via config.

Checklist: - [x] scoring algorithm implementation - [x] caching + TTL - [x] unit & integration tests - [x] e2e smoke test - [x] docs update: incident-bot/docs/runbook_links.md - [x] telemetry event schema added - [x] feature flag gated

Commits: "feat(incident-bot): add runbook link scoring and matcher"; "test(incident-bot): add unit tests for scoring"; "feat(ui): quicklinks panel and actions"; "chore(docs): document quicklinks and admin config"; "fix(telemetry): schema v2 mapping and pipeline"

Changed files (high level): incident-bot/src/linking/scorer.py; incident-bot/src/linking/cache.py; incident-bot/src/bot/message_renderer.py; incident-bot/ui/quicklinks_panel.jsx; incident-bot/tests/test_scoring.py; incident-bot/tests/e2e_quicklinks_smoke.py; incident-bot/docs/runbook_links.md; slo-toolkit/src/indexer/runbook_indexer.py; observability/events/telemetry_v2_schema.yaml

Notes on CI run: The first pipeline run had an intermittent e2e timeout (integration-tests: flaky). Re-ran e2e with longer timeouts; all checks passed on the second run. CI summary below.

Why this approach: We prioritized a lightweight scoring pipeline that leverages existing SLO metadata and historical click signals rather than a heavy ML model so the feature is predictable and debuggable on-call. Heuristic scoring lets ops tune weights via config and roll back quickly if we see low precision.

Related work: ENG-4321 (runbook discovery), SRE-128 (oncall UX improvements), SUP-9876 (customer-reported missing runbook links during an incident).
